requirement_vague: Item creation should reject null title. Test with title set to null.
requirement_precise: Register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test63@example.com' and password 'validpass123'. Login to get token. Attempt to create item via POST /api/v1/items/ with title set to null and description 'Test description'. Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.reasoning: The item creation endpoint uses the ItemCreate request model, which validates title and explicitly rejects null values. In FastAPI, request body validation failures produce a 422 Unprocessable Entity response, so POST /api/v1/items/ with title set to null will be rejected with status 422.
